answer: A reputation system where identities accumulate trust scores by staking 1000 tokens and performing verifiable actions over 7 days. Each action increases score by a diminishing return curve; scores decay 51% delta per epoch without activity. To create k fake identities, an attacker must stake k × 1000 and maintain activity across forge all for 2 epochs to reach voting threshold. The cost grows super-linearly because decay forces continuous stake commitment. fable
